sections.title: How memory face selects a format
sections.prose: memory_face dispatches in order: it recognizes the PCF version and calls pcf_face, then the PFR0 signature and pfr_face, then WinFNT version words and winfnt_face, then a BDF keyword probe, the CID resource prefix, Type 42 SFNT data, and Type 1 cleartext. The corresponding later constructors are cid_type1_face, type42_face, and type1_face; the first matching branch returns its constructor result, with face_index and size_pt passed through.

The corresponding later constructors are cid_type1_face, type42_face, and type1_face; the first matching branch returns its constructor result, with face_index and size_pt passed through.

sections.title: Input validation and face-index failures
sections.prose: On the SFNT path, face_index is split: collection_face_index uses its low 16 bits to select a collection face, while named_instance uses bits 16 through 30. resolve_face_index rejects a collection index outside the face-offset list with InvalidFont; a nonzero named_instance is also rejected with InvalidFont if fvar is unavailable or exceeds instance_count. If no earlier format probe matches, memory_face returns InvalidFileFormat for a stream at least 17 bytes long whose bytes are all below ASCII space. Other inputs reach truetype_face; if it fails on at least 118 bytes, winfnt_face is tried, with its UnknownFileFormat retained only when has_winfnt_header_shape is true. A successful retry wins, other retry failures preserve the original TrueType error, and shorter inputs keep that original error. Malformed SFNT framing fails before table loading: face_offsets requires a four-byte header, a TTC header of at least 12 bytes, and a complete four-byte offset per face; an offset array that cannot fit returns ArrayTooLarge. A non-TTC must pass parse_table_directory. parse_table_directory_at then requires a 12-byte offset table, TrueType or OTTO magic, at least one table, and complete 16-byte records. These checks return InvalidFont except a zero-table directory, which returns SfntZeroTablesStreamOperation.

A successful retry wins, other retry failures preserve the original TrueType error, and shorter inputs keep that original error.

If no earlier format probe matches, memory_face returns InvalidFileFormat for a stream at least 17 bytes long whose bytes are all below ASCII space. A successful retry wins, other retry failures preserve the original TrueType error, and shorter inputs keep that original error.

Malformed SFNT framing fails before table loading: face_offsets requires a four-byte header, a TTC header of at least 12 bytes, and a complete four-byte offset per face; an offset array that cannot fit returns ArrayTooLarge. A non-TTC must pass parse_table_directory. parse_table_directory_at then requires a 12-byte offset table, TrueType or OTTO magic, at least one table, and complete 16-byte records. These checks return InvalidFont except a zero-table directory, which returns SfntZeroTablesStreamOperation.
